# Swiss grid — Style Prompt

> A printed information page that sets itself. Grey paper, black ink and one signal colour on a locked six-column grid with registration marks; every line of text rises out of its own baseline, a short knife line cuts under the one word that matters and colours it, lists arrive number first, figures climb in hard mechanical steps, and between beats six ink columns drop over the page like a guillotine and lift away on the next. Two curves only, no shadows, no camera: the layout is the only thing that moves.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The video is **a sequence of typeset pages on one fixed grid**, in the spirit of Swiss International Style posters and explainer infographics. Paper, ink and a single signal colour; every element sits flush left on the 80 px margins; each beat is one page in one of three layouts (chapter split, head-top list, low-left figure); motion lands on the beat and stops dead. Information is the decoration: a giant numeral, a hairline, a mono label.

It is not a slideshow of cards (no boxes, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glows, no gradients), not playful (no springs, overshoot, wobble, rotation or bounce: only one snap curve and linear), not cinematic (the camera never moves, no zooms, no parallax, no dissolves: pages change only by the ink column wipe), not colourful (the signal colour marks one thing per beat; everything else is ink or grey). Best for mechanism explainers, data and comparisons, process breakdowns, rules and steps.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Paper**: one flat ground colour, no grain, no vignette, no texture beyond the grid.
- **Grid**: vertical hairlines 2 px wide every 134 px starting at the 80 px margin (ink at 11%), the same on every page and never moving. Margins 80 px left and right; text never crosses them.
- **Registration marks**: two 44 px L-shaped corners, 2 px ink at 50%, top left at (40, 180) and bottom right at (right 40, bottom 260). They frame the live area like a print sheet.
- **Rules**: a 3 px rule the full grid width under chapter and closing titles (85% opacity); 2 px hairlines at 11% ink under each list row.
- **Masks**: every text block sits in an `overflow: hidden` box padded 0.06 em top and 0.12 em bottom (with the same negative margins) so descenders and commas survive the clip.
- **Series tag** in the footer (left 80 px, bottom 300 px), still for the whole video: a mono label, the name in the headline face with a small grey secondary word, and three palette dots (34 px: paper, ink, signal; the paper dot almost invisible, which indents the row).
- **Ink columns**: six full-height panels, 180 px wide (181 px to avoid seams), in the text colour, above everything during a wipe.
- **One colour field per video at most**: the contact block of the ending, a rectangle in the signal colour with no radius and no shadow.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the paper; `--teks` is the ink: all text, the giant numerals, the registration marks (50%), the grid (`--garis`, 11%), and the wipe panels (`--tinta`), so a dark brand gets light panels and the wipe still reads.
- `--teks-redup` (a mid grey, about 4.6:1 on the paper) carries mono labels, the footer label and the tag's secondary word.
- `--utama` is the signal. As a fill only: the contact block of the ending and the third palette dot. As words and lines on the paper it is always `--utama-di-latar`: list index numbers, knife underlines, and the key word after the cut. On a pale brand (pale yellow on white) those fall back to ink, so the cut still shows as an underline.
- `--teks-di-utama` is the text inside the contact block.
- `--aksen` defaults to ink and appears only as the 3 px title rules (`--aksen-di-latar`): a brand accent shows there and nowhere else.
- `--latar-2` (white surface) is unused in the example; keep it for a white card when a beat must frame a screenshot or photo, never for text panels.
- Fixed in every brand: nothing but these. No second signal colour, no meaning colours, no tints of the signal as backgrounds.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (Inter 800, tracking -0.03 em, line height 1.04, `text-wrap: balance`): chapter and closing titles 140 px, page titles 104 px, list rows 72 px, the figure's unit line 104 px, the footer name 54 px.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600): notes and sources 46 px, line height 1.3.
- Look tokens a brand does not replace: `--font-angka` (Archivo Black) for numerals: the chapter numeral 320 px at -0.04 em, the hero figure 360 px at -0.05 em with tabular figures and the percent sign as a 0.42 em superscript aligned to the top, the tag's secondary word 34 px; `--font-kode` (IBM Plex Mono) for labels 28 px uppercase at +0.08 em, list indexes 32 px, the footer label 24 px at +0.2 em. Set `--font-angka` to `var(--font-judul)` when a brand insists on its own numerals.
- Latin text is set about 10% larger than the CJK sizes of the source (66 to 72, 96 to 104) because its x-height reads smaller.
- When a brand has no fonts: a neutral or grotesque sans (Inter, Space Grotesk 700, Noto Sans Bold) for headlines, Archivo Black for numbers. Never a serif, script or rounded face here.
- A wider brand font wraps sooner: the chapter block grows upward from its bottom anchor and the figure block likewise, so keep titles to about three words a line rather than shrinking below 120 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Two curves**: `cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1)` (snap) for every entrance, exit, cut and wipe; linear for hairlines and counters. No overshoot, no springs, no blur. the timeline core has no custom ease: build the curve as a function (bisection on the bezier) and pass it as `ease`.
- **Clip-rise**: the text box rises inside its mask from `yPercent: 108` to 0 in 0.5 s; consecutive lines of one block 0.08 s apart; no per-letter stagger. Exits are covered by the wipe; when a line must leave on its own, it rises out to -108 in 0.3 s.
- **Knife underline**: a bar 0.09 em tall, 0.06 em below the word, grows from the left (`scaleX` 0 to 1) in 0.32 s snap; on the frame it completes, the word takes the signal colour (a CSS variable `--on` set from 0 to 1).
- **Index-snap row**: the index rises in 0.35 s; the hairline draws linearly in 0.3 s from +0.1 s; the row text rises in 0.45 s from +0.16 s; rows 0.4 s apart.
- **Step-climb**: the figure rises in its mask (0.5 s) while it counts from zero, linearly, in hard steps of 1/13 s for 0.9 s (12 steps), ending on the exact value with the Indonesian decimal comma.
- **Rule cut-in**: the 3 px rule grows from the left in 0.5 s snap, 0.25-0.3 s after its title starts.
- **Column wipe**: six panels drop from the top (`scaleY` 0 to 1, origin top) in 0.32 s, 0.035 s apart left to right; the page is covered at +0.495 s, the scenes swap under the cover, and the panels lift to the bottom (origin bottom) in the same order from 0.02 s later; about 1 s in all.
- **Holds**: text being read holds at least 1.2 s; in the reference a list page holds about 3 s after its last row and a figure page about 2 s after its last cut. The ending holds still at least 2 s and does not fade (dissolves are not in this grammar).
- **Opening**: the video may begin mid-wipe (panels lifting, the chapter numeral half risen), as if cut from a longer piece, so the first frame is already a page.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked. Every "move" is a layout move on the fixed grid.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame | the grid is the authority; attention goes to whatever changes | every beat |
| Column wipe, down then down-out | a page turns, a new chapter | between beats, before the ending |
| Clip-rise from the baseline | information set in place, line by line | titles, statements, list rows, notes |
| Knife underline | this one counts | the key word, the number that matters, a price, a deadline |
| Step-climb | measured, mechanical growth | a score, a share, a count, a speed |
| Rule cut-in | a statement is closed | under a chapter or closing title |
| Colour block cut-in from the left | the single action to take | the contact, the booking line |

## 7. Native moves

- **Chapter split.** A two-digit numeral at 320 px fills the top left; the title, a full-width 3 px rule and a mono sub-label sit at the bottom of the same column, the space between them empty. *Fits content like:* "01 · Menyapa tanpa suara" opening a sign-language class; "02 · Bongkar mesin jahit" in a repair shop's series; a creator's episode number before the topic; the first chapter of a short mystery.
- **Ink column wipe.** Six ink panels drop over the page left to right and lift away on the next page. *Fits content like:* from the problem to the fix in a cleaning service's video; between the steps of a recipe channel; from the question to the answer in a quiz; from "before" to "after" in a renovation story.
- **Knife underline.** A short bar cuts under one word and the word takes the signal colour. *Fits content like:* the "3" in "3 isyarat dasar"; the "1 hari" in a print shop's turnaround; the sample size under a creator's poll; the one name that matters in a story's line.
- **Index-first list.** The coloured mono number snaps up, a hairline draws, then the item rises; one row every 0.4 s. *Fits content like:* three steps of booking a workshop; a bakery's three bestsellers; the three rules of a study method; three clues in a short story.
- **Step-climb figure.** A 360 px numeral flush left on the bottom margin climbs in hard 13 fps steps, its unit and a source line rising under it. *Fits content like:* "86,4% lancar menyapa" for a class; "1.240 pesanan" for a catering business; "92% penonton bertahan" for a channel; "40 km" walked in a travel story.
- **Signal block.** On the ending, the contact sits in the only colour field of the video, cut in from the left before its text rises. *Fits content like:* "chat 0812-3456-7890" for a course; a booking line for a barbershop; a channel's handle; the date of a premiere.
- **Series tag.** The footer carries the label, the name and the palette dots, still on every page like a printed folio. *Fits content like:* a class batch; a shop and its city; a creator's series and episode; a story's chapter count.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **One signal per beat.** The index numbers count as one family, the knife word as one element; a second coloured thing on the same page and the colour stops signalling.
- **No decoration.** No shadow, glow, gradient, radius, blur, spring, bounce, rotation or dissolve. If a page looks empty, that is the style: do not fill it.
- **The grid never moves.** Grid lines, registration marks and the series tag stay put; no drifting background, no camera push.
- **Masks.** Without the 0.06/0.12 em padding pair descenders, commas and the knife bar get clipped. Keep the knife inside the mask's bottom padding.
- **Counting.** Use timeline `set`s of exact strings, not an `onUpdate` counter; the figure is masked before its rise, so the text the sets revert to is never seen when seeking. Never invent a figure; say where it comes from in the note.
- **Colours on the paper.** Words and lines use `--utama-di-latar`, never `--utama`; the block uses `--utama` with `--teks-di-utama`. Wipe panels are `--teks`, never the signal (one signal) and never `--latar-2`.
- **Safe zones.** Keep titles, figures and the contact between y 250 and 1500 within the 80 px margins; the series tag is an identity strip that sits lower by design, so nothing the viewer must act on goes there.
- **Wide brand fonts.** Let titles wrap into balanced lines; never shrink headlines below 120 px or list rows below 64 px.
- **Performance.** Panels move by `scaleY`, rules and bars by `scaleX`, text by `yPercent`. Give the six panels and the masked text boxes `will-change: transform` (solid panels and unscaled text stay sharp as layers); without it every wipe frame repaints the whole page, which halves the live preview's frame rate on a slow phone. Hide pages that are off screen with `autoAlpha`. Never animate box-shadow or filters.

## Variation space

Layouts per page, all on the same margins: chapter split, left-middle, centred, top, low-left or right-middle; list head-top, centred, article (title higher, list at 660 px) or low (title at 560 px, list at 930 px); figure low-left, left, centred or top-left. A beat may use the chapter numeral as a step counter (01, 02, 03) instead of a list.

## Measured from the reference

13 s in three pages: chapter 0-2.1 s (numeral and title already rising at 0 s, rule and sub by 0.75 s), list 3.1-8.1 s (title at 3.1 s, knife at 3.6 s, rows at 4.2, 4.55 and 4.9 s, then a 3 s hold), figure 9.0-13.1 s (rising from 9.0 s, climbing to 10.25 s, unit at 10.5 s, note at 10.75 s, knife at about 11 s, then a 2 s hold). Wipes at 2.1-3.1 s and 8.1-9.0 s, covered at 2.5 and 8.5 s. Layout anchors at 1080×1920: chapter block top 200, bottom 560 from the foot; page label at 420, list at 820 (rows about 125 px apart); figure bottom 560 from the foot; series tag bottom 300.

# Swiss grid: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.4, long 4.6.

## hook

- en: a giant ink chapter numeral rises top left; the title rises low left over a full-width 3 px rule cut in from the left
- id: angka bab raksasa naik di kiri atas; judul naik di kiri bawah, di atas garis 3 px selebar grid yang dipotong dari kiri

## problem

- en: the trouble rises flush left as one line; a knife line cuts under the faulty word, which takes the signal colour
- id: masalahnya naik rata kiri dalam satu baris; garis pisau menggores di bawah kata yang salah, kata itu jadi berwarna sinyal

## fact

- en: a mono label, then the statement rises in its mask, 0.08 s later; a knife underline lands on the key word
- id: label huruf kode, lalu pernyataannya naik dari maskernya 0,08 detik kemudian; garis pisau mendarat di kata kunci

## step

- en: index-first list: the coloured mono number snaps up, a hairline draws, the step text rises; one row every 0.4 s
- id: daftar bernomor: nomor kode berwarna naik dulu, garis tipis ditarik, teks langkah menyusul; satu baris tiap 0,4 detik

## compare

- en: two grid columns under one label; rows rise in pairs, the winning cell gets the knife underline and the colour
- id: dua kolom grid di bawah satu label; baris naik berpasangan, sel pemenang digores garis pisau dan jadi berwarna

## number

- en: the figure at hero size flush left on the bottom margin climbs in hard 13 fps steps; unit and note rise under it
- id: angka raksasa rata kiri di margin bawah memanjat dalam lompatan kasar; satuan dan catatan naik di bawahnya

## proof

- en: a hero figure or a quote rises; a mono source line follows with a knife underline under the sample size
- id: angka besar atau kutipan naik; baris sumber huruf kode menyusul, jumlah sampelnya digores garis pisau

## offer

- en: the offer rises flush left; the old price is cut through by the knife line, the new price rises in the same row
- id: penawaran naik rata kiri; harga lama dicoret garis pisau, harga baru naik di baris yang sama

## cta

- en: ink columns wipe, the title rises over its rule, the contact sits in the one colour block cut in from the left; hold 2 s
- id: kolom tinta menyapu, judul naik di atas garisnya, kontak di satu-satunya blok warna yang dipotong dari kiri; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: ink columns clear the page to one line flush left; the knife underlines its key word, then all holds 2 s
- id: kolom tinta menyisakan satu baris rata kiri; garis pisau menggores kata kuncinya, lalu semua diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Grid Swiss</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #eae9e5; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #e30613; --aksen: #111111;
        --teks: #111111; --teks-redup: #6b6b6b; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff; --utama-di-latar: #e30613; --aksen-di-latar: #111111;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya, bukan brand: angka tebal, huruf kode, tinta panel, garis grid. */
        --font-angka: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        --tinta: var(--teks);
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 11%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); font-weight: 600; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      /* Tekstur terkunci: garis kolom tiap 134 px dari margin 80 px, dua tanda register. Tidak pernah bergerak. */
      .tex { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      .kolom { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 132px, var(--garis) 132px 134px); background-position: 80px 0; }
      .reg::before, .reg::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--teks); opacity: 0.5; }
      .reg::before { left: 40px; top: 180px; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; }
      .reg::after { right: 40px; bottom: 260px; border-left: none; border-top: none; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Masker clip-rise: teks naik dari bawah garis dasarnya, tanpa blur. */
      .m { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.06em 0 0.12em; margin: -0.06em 0 -0.12em; }
      /* will-change: teks dan panel jadi lapisan sendiri, jadi geraknya tidak melukis ulang seluruh halaman. */
      .m > i { display: block; font-style: normal; will-change: transform; }
      .label { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 400; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.04; text-wrap: balance; }
      .garis { height: 3px; background: var(--aksen-di-latar); opacity: 0.85; transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Bab (split): angka raksasa di atas, judul rata kiri di bawah, di atas garis 3 px selebar grid. */
      .bab { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 200px; bottom: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; }
      .bab .num { margin-bottom: auto; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 400; font-size: 320px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
      .bab .ttl { font-size: 140px; }
      .bab .garis, .kepala .garis { margin-top: 30px; }
      .bab .sub { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Kepala + daftar (head-top). */
      .kepala { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; }
      .kepala .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 104px; }
      .kepala .ttl.besar { font-size: 140px; }
      .daftar { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 820px; list-style: none; }
      .daftar li { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 28px; padding: 26px 0; }
      .daftar .idx { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 32px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); min-width: 70px; }
      .daftar .txt { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 72px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
      .daftar .rule { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--garis); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Angka (low-left): angka raksasa rata kiri, berdiri di margin bawah. */
      .angka, .ajak { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 560px; }
      .val { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 400; font-size: 360px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
      .pct { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 0.04em; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.1em; }
      .unit { font-size: 104px; margin-top: 18px; }
      .note { margin-top: 44px; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.3; }
      /* Kata kunci: pisau warna utama menggores di bawahnya, lalu katanya ikut berwarna. */
      .kunci { position: relative; display: inline-block; --on: 0; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) calc(var(--on) * 100%), var(--teks)); }
      .kunci b { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -0.06em; height: 0.09em; background: var(--utama-di-latar); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Satu-satunya bidang warna: blok kontak, dipotong masuk dari kiri. */
      .ajak .note { margin: 0 0 28px; }
      .blok { display: inline-block; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); padding: 26px 34px 22px; transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .wa { display: block; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 68px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.05; white-space: nowrap; }
      /* Tanda tangan seri di kaki halaman: diam sepanjang video. */
      .tag { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .tag .k { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 400; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .tag .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; }
      .tag small { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 400; font-size: 34px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-left: 16px; }
      .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      /* Palet: kertas (hampir tak terlihat), tinta, warna utama. */
      .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; outline: 1px solid var(--garis); background: var(--latar); }
      .sw i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--teks); }
      .sw i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--utama); }
      /* Tirai: enam panel tinta selebar satu kolom. */
      #tirai { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; }
      #tirai i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 181px; background: var(--tinta); will-change: transform; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="tex kolom"></div>
      <div class="tex reg"></div>

      <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="bab">
          <div class="num">01</div>
          <h1 class="judul ttl">Menyapa tanpa suara</h1>
          <div class="garis"></div>
          <div class="label sub">Kelas bahasa isyarat · pemula</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="kepala">
          <div class="label">Pekan pertama</div>
          <h2 class="judul ttl"><span class="kunci">3</span> isyarat dasar</h2>
        </div>
        <ol class="daftar">
          <li><span class="idx">01</span><span class="txt">Halo</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
          <li><span class="idx">02</span><span class="txt">Terima kasih</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
          <li><span class="idx">03</span><span class="txt">Minta tolong</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
        </ol>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="angka">
          <div class="val"><span class="n">86,4</span><span class="pct">%</span></div>
          <div class="judul unit">lancar menyapa</div>
          <div class="note">dalam 6 pekan · data <span class="kunci">140</span> murid</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s4" data-role="cta">
        <div class="kepala">
          <div class="label">Pendaftaran dibuka</div>
          <h2 class="judul ttl besar">Mulai Sabtu ini</h2>
          <div class="garis"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ajak">
          <div class="note">09.00–11.00 · Rp150.000 / bulan</div>
          <div class="blok"><span class="wa">Chat 0812-3456-7890</span></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="tag">
        <div class="k">KELAS SABTU · ANGKATAN 12</div>
        <div class="n">Rumah Isyarat<small>Bandung</small></div>
        <div class="sw"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
      </div>
      <div id="tirai"></div>
